### GET /api/v1/comments

List review comments for a composer group

Returns the flat comment list plus the caller's mute and read state for the group. Any org member of the group's organization may read. A brand-new unsaved draft (no group row yet) returns an empty result.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `groupId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — Comments, mute state and read state for the group.
  - `CommentsList`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `comments`: array of `Comment`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `parentId`: string | null, required
      - `accountId`: string | null, required
      - `threadPosition`: number | null, required
      - `quote`: string | null, required
      - `body`: string, required
      - `attachments`: array of `CommentAttachment`, required
        - `url`: string, required
        - `mimeType`: string, required
      - `mentions`: array of `CommentMention`, required
        - `userId`: string, required
        - `name`: string, required
      - `reactions`: array of `CommentReaction`, required
        - `emoji`: string, required
        - `count`: number, required
        - `reactedByMe`: boolean, required
      - `resolved`: boolean, required
      - `createdAt`: number, required — Epoch ms.
      - `author`: object, required
        - `id`: string, required
        - `name`: string, required
        - `avatarUrl`: string | null, required
      - `kind`: one of `"comment"` | `"suggestion"`, required — "comment" (default) or "suggestion" — a tracked insert/delete made in suggestion mode.
      - `suggestionType`: one of `"insert"` | `"delete"` | `"replace"` | `null`, required
      - `suggestionStatus`: one of `"pending"` | `"accepted"` | `"rejected"` | `null`, required
    - `postMuted`: boolean, required
    - `mutedThreadIds`: array of string, required
    - `readState`: object, required — threadId → lastReadAt (epoch ms) for the requesting user.
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/comments

Create a comment

Adds a top-level review comment (or a tracked suggestion) to a composer group. Any member of the group's organization may comment. Retrying with the same `id` is idempotent.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `CreateCommentBody`
  - `groupId`: string, required — The composer group the comment belongs to.
  - `id`: string (uuid)
  - `accountId`: string | null
  - `threadPosition`: number | null
  - `quote`: string | null
  - `body`: string
  - `attachments`: array of any
  - `mentions`: array of any
  - `kind`: one of `"comment"` | `"suggestion"`
  - `suggestionType`: one of `"insert"` | `"delete"` | `"replace"`

**Responses**

- `200` — The comment was created; `id` is the persisted id.
  - `CreatedComment`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
    - `id`: string, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — Group not found
  - `Error`

### PUT /api/v1/comments/post-mute

Mute or unmute the whole post's comments

Sets the caller's post-level subscription: muted unsubscribes them from all comment activity on the group. Per-user — nobody else's notifications change.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `SetPostMuteBody`
  - `groupId`: string, required — The composer group the comment belongs to.
  - `muted`: boolean, required

**Responses**

- `200` — The operation was applied
  - `CommentActionResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — Group not found
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/comments/{id}/replies

Adds a reply under a top-level comment. Replies can't nest further. Retrying with the same `id` is idempotent.

### DELETE /api/v1/comments/{id}

Delete a comment

Removes a comment or reply. Authors delete their own; a caller with `comment:manageAny` (manager and up) may also remove someone else's. Deleting a top-level comment removes its whole thread.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

### POST /api/v1/comments/{id}/decision

Accept or reject a suggestion

Decides a tracked suggestion, marking it resolved. The decision is terminal: retrying the same decision is idempotent, flipping it is a conflict.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `SuggestionDecisionBody`
  - `groupId`: string, required — The composer group the comment belongs to.
  - `decision`: one of `"accepted"` | `"rejected"`, required

**Responses**

- `200` — The operation was applied
  - `CommentActionResult`
    - `ok`: literal `true`, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — Group or suggestion not found
  - `Error`
- `409` — The suggestion was already decided the other way
